Worked on designing the initial PCB. Added all the DRVs, PCBs, and wired up the literal dozens of required capacitors. Most of it is done, but I still have to finish routing and placing all the tiny components.

### 2026-10-06 — - Finished the PCB design, had to redesign the entire PCB to adjust for the space constraints, so I added 2 new layers: GND and VIN

**6h**

- Finished the PCB design, had to redesign the entire PCB to adjust for the space constraints, so I added 2 new layers: GND and VIN
-Added boot/reset buttons and a USB-C 2.0 programming port
-Added extra vias everywhere so as to not short out the power traces when running high-current motors
-Ran DRC multiple times to get rid of loose, unconnected traces (all meaningful errors and warnings gone; what's left is just footprint overlap stuff with the servo pins connector, which is not a problem.)

### 2026-10-07 — Digital testing using Wokwi, I wrote INO code and worked for quite a bit to arrange the serial commands to the servos. I kept having indexing problems, but that was because I apparently mismatched the

**5h**

Digital testing using Wokwi, I wrote INO code and worked for quite a bit to arrange the serial commands to the servos. I kept having indexing problems, but that was because I apparently mismatched the digital pins to the numbers in the code. Finally finished code with serial commands to adjust servo angles and motor speeds.
